messages:
priya_cs: Hi team — onboarding for Novara is moving to the security review stage. They handed back the vendor risk form but have a few conditional requests around MFA and session rotations. Can someone confirm what we can provide as evidence?

jules_sec: We can provide our SOC2 control mapping for auth (section: Access Control). Also screenshots of Conditional Access policy in the Console and recent audit logs.

anita_onboard: Great. Novara specifically asked: 1) do we enforce MFA for all console access? 2) session token rotation TTL for API keys / service tokens? They want exact TTL and rotation cadence.

jules_sec: MFA: yes — enforced for all human console users via SSO + 2nd factor (Okta). For service accounts we recommend rotating keys; we don't require 2FA on API keys. Evidence: export from Okta and a screenshot of the CA policy.

priya_cs: Novara is asking if we have a policy doc with cadence (e.g., rotate keys every 90 days) or is that just a recommendation?

jules_sec: We have an internal rotation guideline: default 90 days for user creds, 30 days recommended for short-lived service tokens. For long-lived API keys we capture creation + last rotated timestamps — can export CSV from the key management view. That's our evidence.

anita_onboard: Perfect. I'll pull the CSV. Which console path is that?

jules_sec: Console > Settings > API Keys > Export. The exported CSV has columns: id, created_at, last_rotated_at, owner. You can redact IDs if needed.

priya_cs: Also — Novara asked about session idle timeout for web console (they want to know if sessions expire after inactivity). What do we say?

jules_sec: Default idle timeout is 30 minutes. We enforce re-auth for privileged actions. We can screenshot the session policy page.

anita_onboard: Quick note from deploy-bot: "deploy-bot: automation: export completed for API keys (file: exports/novara/api_keys_2026-03-21.csv)" :memo:

priya_cs: Thanks — I'll attach the CSV and the Okta CA screenshot to the vendor form reply. Anything else Novara typically asks about?

jules_sec: They sometimes ask about BYOK/HSM for key provenance. Clarify that customer-managed KMS is available on Private and Dedicated plans; hosted customers use our managed KMS.

anita_onboard: I'll add that to the response and flag for Sales if they want BYOK options.

priya_cs: Drafting reply now, will ping for a quick review before sending. :thumbsup:
